title: Towards Matrix-Free Patch Smoothers for the Stokes Problem: Evaluating Local p-Multigrid Solvers
summary: Vertex-patch smoothers offer an effective strategy for achieving robust geometric multigrid convergence for the Stokes equations, particularly in the context of high-order finite elements. However, their practical efficiency is often limited by the computational cost of solving the local saddle-point problems, especially when explicit matrix factorizations are not feasible. We explore a fully iterative, matrix-free-compatible approach to the local patch solve using $p$-multigrid techniques.
